_note: Every strategy this project has tested, with the number that decided it. Status is the honest verdict, not the hopeful one. WITHDRAWN means it was published here and later retracted - those stay visible on purpose so the retraction is as findable as the claim was.

strategies.name: Volatility-managed VFV
strategies.rule: weight = min(1, (10% annual vol target / sqrt(252)) / trailing 20-day realised vol). Long VFV.TO at that weight, cash otherwise.
strategies.mechanism: Volatility is strongly autocorrelated and forecastable; returns are not. Scaling down in turbulent regimes cuts risk more than it cuts return.
strategies.benchmark: buy & hold VFV: +17.50% CAGR, Sharpe 1.11, maxDD -27.4%
strategies.caveat: Gives up 3.5pp of CAGR versus buy-and-hold. It wins on risk-adjusted terms, not on raw return.

strategies.name: Trend long/flat XIU
strategies.rule: Long XIU.TO when its close has been above the 100-day SMA for 3 consecutive days; otherwise cash.
strategies.mechanism: Slow information diffusion, periodic institutional rebalancing, and risk-management flows that are themselves momentum.
strategies.benchmark: buy & hold XIU: +9.35% CAGR, Sharpe 0.62, maxDD -47.9%
strategies.caveat: Defensive, not a return engine. Turns a -47.9% drawdown into -14.4% at the cost of ~1pp of CAGR.

strategies.name: Forced-flow continuation (S3)
strategies.rule: Volume spike >= 1.5x the 20-day average; follow the day's direction; 10-day hold; 2.5x ATR stop.
strategies.mechanism: Liquidation cascades. The margin engine must market-sell regardless of price, and cannot choose to stop.
strategies.caveat: Overlaps 0.85-1.00 with D1 - they are one bet expressed twice, not two.

strategies.name: Basis dislocation (B1)
strategies.rule: Fade the perp/spot premium when it reaches its trailing 90th percentile; exit on normalisation or timeout.
strategies.mechanism: Reversion against a REAL anchor - a spot price arbitrageurs can trade against. The only reversion strategy of five tested that survived.
strategies.caveat: Does NOT work on SOL. Shortest history in the book, and its most recent half-year is negative.

strategies.name: Gated overnight VFV
strategies.rule: Buy at the close, sell at the next open, gated on trend + vol target + VIX contango.
strategies.caveat: RETRACTED. VFV and ZSP track the same index and showed overnight returns differing by 5.7pp/yr - economically impossible. Re-run on instruments with trustworthy opening prints (SPY, XSP.TO), alpha t falls to -0.27 and -1.43 under realistic fills. The headline was ~15pp/yr of bad opening prices.

strategies.name: Polymarket near-expiry calibration
strategies.rule: Open question: does a contract priced ~0.80 shortly before expiry resolve YES more often than 0.80 implies?
strategies.mechanism: Favourite-longshot bias, documented as strongest close to the event.
strategies.caveat: Cannot be backtested - Polymarket serves no price history for resolved markets. Forward collection running at ~3s cadence. Settlement is Chainlink 60s TWAP, NOT spot, so gap columns recorded before that discovery use the wrong reference.

strategies.name: Rejected (17 crypto + 8 mechanisms + 6 Polymarket angles)
strategies.rule: Kept as a record so dead ends are not re-run.
strategies.mechanism: RELATIONAL strategies went 0-for-4. REVERSION toward a computed statistic went 0-for-4; only reversion against a real spot anchor survived.
strategies.caveat: Includes: turn-of-month, leveraged overnight (twice), diversified overnight basket, daily VWAP (96-99% identical to a plain SMA), opening-range/VWAP on QQQ+GLD+BTC, all intraday crypto, coin expansion, volatility targeting and risk parity on crypto, Polymarket coherence arbitrage.
